why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. Item 1: Check 6 in the verifier brief bases PASS/FAIL on "npm test; echo \"exit=$?\"" plus a grep for the test. `npm run test:cli` shows up only under "Advisory (not part of PASS/FAIL)", which says the script doesn't exist and makes running it optional, with the result only reported. No verdict depends on it. Item 2: the builder brief asks only for a check for "--tsv" in argv, and says outright "don't add --help, --sep or auto-detection". It never asks for a general --sep or --delimiter option. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
